evidence: Template library grid shows 6 templates, each with title, description, author, use count, update date.
Each card shows template name, author, description, category/type tags, and 'Updated YYYY-MM-DD'.
Clicking 'Use Template' opens a dialog for the selected template (Professional Resume) with Fill Template/Preview Result tabs and template-specific form fields.
With required fields empty, 'Preview Result' tab is disabled and a warning banner lists missing required fields.
Red warning banner 'Required fields missing' with list of fields appears, and Preview tab is visually disabled.
All 14 form fields (13 required + phone) accepted typed values; warning banner cleared after filling.
Preview Result tab became enabled and rendered a formatted resume reflecting entered data.

Preview shows 'John Smith', 'Software Engineer | john@example.com | ...', Tech Corp — Senior Developer, Jan 2020 - Present, responsibilities, degree/school/year, and skills exactly as entered, rendered as formatted Markdown (headings, bold, italics).

Preview renders proper Markdown formatting: H1 name, bold job title, section headings (Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills), italic date range, bold company/degree — no raw markdown syntax or errors visible.
Clicking 'Copy to Clipboard' shows toast 'Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied.'

issue: Special characters not restricted in form input
actual: Typing '¥#@%^*' into the required 'Full Name' field was accepted without filtering, blocking, or any 'Special characters are prohibited' message. Field value became '¥#@%^*John Smith'.

issue: No visual feedback when entering special characters
actual: Typing special characters '¥#@%^*' into Full Name field produced no warning, error styling, or blocking feedback of any kind.

Entered an invalid date '13/45/2020' (month 13, day 45) into the required 'Start Date' field of the Resume template; the form accepted it with no error, and the Preview tab became enabled without any date-format warning.

issue: No validation that start date precedes end date
actual: Entered Start Date '13/45/2020' and End Date '2015' (earlier than start) in the Resume form; no validation error was shown and Preview tab was enabled, allowing generation with an end date before the start date.

evidence: Clicking heart icon on 'Professional Resume' card updated the header 'Favorites' button to show a badge count of 1, and the heart button became active/highlighted.
Favoriting a template and clicking 'Favorites' filters the library to show only the favorited template ('Showing 1 of 6 templates').
Favorites view shows the saved 'Professional Resume' template card; the search box remains available to search within this view.
Typing partial keyword 'resu' (not exact) matched and filtered to 'Professional Resume', demonstrating fuzzy substring matching.
As 'resu' was typed, the results list updated live to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' without needing to submit the search.
Typing 'resu' displayed a real-time suggestion dropdown with 'Professional Resume'; clicking it populated the search box with the full template name and filtered the list to show that exact template.
Category filter (Resume) narrowed to 1/6; Scenario filter (Academic) narrowed to 1/6 showing Academic Research Summary; Sort By offers Most Popular, Recently Updated, Oldest First, Alphabetical.

Clicking 'Submit Template' with empty Title/Author/Description/Content fields produced a toast 'Missing required fields — Please fill in all required fields.' and the dialog stayed open without submitting.

Filled Submit Template form (title, author, description, Markdown content with {{fields}}, one defined field) and clicked Submit; toast 'Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library.' appeared.

After submission, library count changed from 'Showing 6 of 6' to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' and a new card 'Simple Cover Letter' by 'Timothee Issenmann' appeared, immediately usable via 'Use Template'.
New template appeared instantly in the grid without page reload, with correct name/author/description/category/date; library counter updated in sync (6→7).

issue: No Markdown syntax validation on submission
actual: Submitted a template with deliberately malformed Markdown (unclosed link/bold syntax, broken table, unclosed code fence) and the system accepted it without any warning, showing 'Template submitted!' and adding it to the library ('Broken Markdown Test').
